title: Control SN, biological rep 1
treatment_protocol_ch1: Mice were treated with 4mg/kg MPTP for 2 or 10 days or an equal volume of saline.  Mice were sacrificed 7 days after last injection.  Brains were removed and stored at -80C until laser capture microdissection.
growth_protocol_ch1: Transgenic hTH-GFP mice were singly housed for 9 weeks and treated with MPTP or saline for up to 10 days.
extract_protocol_ch1: Total RNA was extracted using an RNeasy Micro kit (Qiagen) according to manufacturer's protocol.  RNA was amplified and reverse transcribed into cDNA using WT-Ovation Pico RNA Amplification System (Nugen) according to protocol.
label_protocol_ch1: Samples were fragmented and biotin labled using FL-Ovation cDNA Biotin Module V2 (Nugen) according to manufacturer's protocol.
hyb_protocol: Following fragmentation, samples were hybridized for 16-18 hours at on Affymetrix Mouse 430 2.0 gene chip.
scan_protocol: Gene Chips were scanned using Affymetrix Genechip Scanner 3000.
description: gene expression from untreated adult SN
data_processing: The data were analyzed using Genespring 10.0 GX (Agilent Technologies), log2 transformed and RMA normalized.
